# Pack-only implementation order

This document is an import aid, not a repository tracker. Do not copy it into
the live issue board. After import, issue folder placement and `depends_on`
front matter are the sole workflow authority.

## Milestone A — import and semantic contract

1. Import and plan the RFC.
2. Implement the pure publication-placement policy.
3. Bind exact source anchors and placement evidence without using Qt geometry.
4. Implement the canonical permalink representation.

## Milestone B — provider and recovery machinery

5. Add native-line and file-level GitHub wire contracts plus the exact
   unsupported-response classifier.
6. Add repository- and operation-scoped write-capability evidence.
7. Migrate durable recovery from one wire attempt to one logical publication
   with deterministic child attempts.
8. Implement native-first negotiation and the fail-closed fallback transition.

## Milestone C — round trip and product surface

9. Normalize fallback comments back to semantic anchors without hidden metadata.
10. Expose the same comment gesture on every eligible current-head source line.
11. Compose the complete path through the shipped application.
12. Prove automated security, restart, mixed-client, and database-loss behavior.

## Milestone D — direct evidence and closeout

13. Run the designated GitHub.com/GHES interaction and record native/fallback
    behavior.
14. Reconcile documentation and simplify.
15. Replay every acceptance criterion and close only after RFC-BPR-0008 is
    Auto-Verified.

exit_criteria: The retained pack, live source audit, immutable RFC baseline and all fifteen criterion rows are reconciled.
Provider-free policy covers placement, capability, body compatibility and durable fallback authorization, including indeterminate outcomes.
The host validates changed-file membership, current/right head, exact path/blob/line and acting identity; incomplete provider placement remains unknown.
The canonical permalink compiler/parser validates bounded same-authority immutable anchors and preserves reviewer prose byte-for-byte.
milestones.boundary: Complete the authored milestone and release the engineering owner to the coordinator; required external acceptance stays pending until supplied.

exit_criteria: Native and file-subject wire contracts preserve honest remote subject and classify only exact definitive unsupported responses.
Repository/actor/profile/operation/revision-scoped capability evidence is bounded and fresh.
Transactional recovery preserves legacy receipts and unresolved attempts and admits at most one POST-eligible child.
Native-first negotiation preserves the existing authority, cancellation and reconciliation path; ambiguous outcomes never start fallback.
milestones.boundary: Complete the authored milestone and release the engineering owner to the coordinator; required external acceptance stays pending until supplied.

exit_criteria: Compatibility threads rehydrate from ordinary GitHub content and reconcile external edits and replies under canonical identity.
The shipped workbench exposes one representation-blind gesture and typed incompatibility with focus, accessibility, scale and theme evidence.
The real line gesture traverses the selected provider, durable recovery and server refresh into the conversation projection.
Automated decision, recovery, database-loss and mutation-isolation courses pass at the integrated candidate.
milestones.boundary: Complete the authored milestone and release the engineering owner to the coordinator; required external acceptance stays pending until supplied.

exit_criteria: Designated GitHub.com and GHES or explicitly approved recorded-contract evidence establishes exact native/fallback behavior and GitHub-only usability.
Owning architecture, product, UX, security and verification documents agree with the simplified implementation.
All fifteen canonical criteria have direct final-candidate evidence, all cards are accepted, RFC dependencies and canonical closeout order permit closure, and documentation/whitespace gates pass.
